feature_plan.intensity_processing: Raw signed mean of shots 6..N; clip only positive-signal features.
feature_plan.line_processing: Peak of nonnegative core; median of nonnegative sidebands; floor=max(1e-6*band positive p95,1e-12*band positive maximum); log1p(core_peak/max(background,floor)); signed contrast (core_peak-background)/(core_peak+background+floor).
limitations: Nearby transitions and matrix effects can affect every line-window feature.
No isolated-line abundance, concentration, or instrument-causal interpretation.
V1 discarded wavelengths below 350 nm, including these strong Mg UV transitions.

spectral.method: Fixed C=1 balanced logistic, training-fold StandardScaler, StratifiedGroupKFold
spectral.interpretation: Campaign association only: different compositions/materials confound instrumental causes.

limitations: Both v1 development and disclosed former test are now diagnostic/development data.
Campaign differences cannot establish instrument drift without shared controls.
Class-conditional summaries fix one coarse label, not the full matrix composition.
The label-only comparator is not complete composition adjustment or a causal test.
Grouped-CV scores describe these campaigns; no final recognition model is selected.
No blank controls or new unopened spectra are included in this diagnostic.
